Description: cumulative_funding defines the cumulative funding of a perpetual market.
cumulative_price defines the running time-integral of the perp premium ((VWAP - mark_price) / mark_price) i.e., sum(premium * seconds) used to compute the interval’s average premium for funding
the last funding timestamp in seconds
period_start defines the start in seconds of the current funding v2 accrual period
last_premium defines the most recent funding v2 impact premium
last_sample_timestamp defines when in seconds last_premium was sampled
